title: alyssum montanum var. psammeum
intro: Alyssum montanum var. psammeum, commonly known as rock alyssum, is a type of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its ability to aid in digestion, relieve respiratory issues, and reduce inflammation. The health benefits of rock alyssum include its antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing fever, soothing wounds, and calming the nervous system. The bioactive constituents of rock alyssum include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are often used to treat various health conditions.
